purpose: Prevent recruitment or production scoring before the measurement materials, ethics, analysis, and data-lineage requirements are complete.

launch_rule.production_may_begin_only_when: Every required gate has status verified and no unresolved blocking note remains.

gates.name: Ethics and data-use determination
requirements: Document whether formal ethics or institutional review is required for the intended use.
Do not claim exemption without an authorized determination.
Freeze plain-language consent, withdrawal, confidentiality, compensation, retention, and deletion terms.
Use synthetic or properly consented and deidentified item material.

gates.name: Item bank complete
requirements: Exactly 96 item packets exist.
Exactly 24 packets exist in each monitoring class.
Exactly 6 packets exist in every class-by-domain cell.
Every packet includes intention map, response, reason codes, expert rationale, ambiguity notes, source type, version, and digest.
Protected monitoring metadata is absent from rater-facing exports.

gates.name: Independent expert references
requirements: At least three independent expert reviews exist for candidate anchors.
Independent scores and disagreements are preserved.
Rejected and revised candidates remain auditable.
Reference distributions are frozen before rater recruitment.

gates.name: Recruitment and screening materials
requirements: Recruitment copy is frozen.
Eligibility and conflict-of-interest screener is frozen.
Compensation and expected workload are stated accurately.
Automated-assistance prohibition is explicit.

gates.name: Training and certification materials
requirements: Twelve annotated training examples exist.
Twelve unannotated certification examples exist.
Construct-violation test exists.
Certification and second-attempt rules are frozen.
Rater-facing rubric and reason-code guide are frozen.

gates.name: Interface and export validation
requirements: All 12 opaque queues import successfully.
No protected metadata appears in rater-facing payloads.
All required fields export correctly.
Transport failures and incomplete submissions are distinguishable.
A complete dry run reproduces the analysis-ready dataset.

gates.name: Analysis and exclusion freeze
requirements: Primary and secondary outcomes are frozen.
Reliability estimands and uncertainty methods are frozen.
Structural-validity gates are frozen.
Missingness categories and rater exclusion rules are frozen.
Stopping, replacement, adjudication, and sensitivity rules are frozen.
Null and failed-result reporting obligations are frozen.

gates.name: Recruitment complete
requirements: At least 12 production raters pass certification.
Target of 2 certified alternates is attempted and reported.
Recruitment flow and every exclusion or failure are preserved.
No production rater helped create or label the item bank.

gates.name: Preproduction integrity check
requirements: Assignment digest matches the frozen digest.
Item-bank digest matches the frozen manifest.
Rater IDs are separate from contact and payment records.
Protected metadata access is restricted.
Backup and incident-recovery procedures are tested.
No substantive condition labels or participant-effect results have been inspected.

current_readiness.next_action: Complete the ethics/data-use determination and construct the first 24 independently reviewed anchor packets.
